briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 escalate AGI timeline compression

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid intensifying US-China competition. Prompt injection attacks surge in production deployments while regulatory frameworks lag deployment velocity.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced agentic capabilities; Anthropic launched Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-V4 closed the gap on Western models with efficient inference.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA H200 shipments hit 2M units; Microsoft and Google announced joint 500MW data center expansions in Texas and Nevada.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory capture or technical breakthroughs determine the winner of the 2027 AGI race?
